featured_reviews.name: Ashok Saha
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are from Canada and have used J M Mehta travel for our customized 3-week tour of North India in December 2017. This was my wife’s and children’s first trip to India and I wanted to ensure that everything went well. We got quotes from quite a few agencies including the big names like Kesari and Heena Travels from India. J M Mehta was the most competitive offer and HONEST for the exact same itinerary.
Mrs. Tuersey Miranda of J M Mehta did a fantastic job in planning and organizing our trip. She was very prompt and diligent in her responses. She answered every query meticulously and always ready to help. She was always available even with the 10.5 hour of time difference between Canada and India. She even responded immediately to a text message sent late at night when we had an issue at one of the hotels during my trip. The driver she organized- Sumer Singh was very courteous, respectful and very helpful. I am extremely pleased with the great service provided and will use them in future. I have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone looking for a great travel experience in India.

Update October 2022.
Based on my great experience in December 2017 I thought that this travel agency should be my go to travel agent for my next trip that I wanted to take in September 2022. I regret to state things have gone completely downhill now. Mrs. Miranda is no longer with J.M.Mehta Travel and no one gives a damn about customer service anymore. I sent several emails, made multiple overseas calls, even had my sister who lives in Mumbai to call them but I was not even able to solicit any response from this company to my request for a quote for a custom package to Kerala. The query form in their website does not go through neither do the emails to most of the contacts listed in their website. The telephone numbers listed on their website also are sketchy at best. I was finally able to find out the contact details of Nilesh Sharma, Operation Head JMM Travel & Tour Co. I explained to him that I was a returning customer and was very interested in using them again. But sadly nothing worked and I finally decided to move on. It is best to avoid this agency as soliciting even a courtesy response is going to be a wild goose chase. If one as to chase this agency just to give them business then you can imagine how responsive they are going to be once they have your money.
In the meantime I was able to find a great alternative and had a great trip to Kerala. I will be positing my review for that in a few days.

featured_reviews.name: Nitish Tambve
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good management and affordable packages make them a good choice for group tours. My mother frequently travels with them and has had memorable experiences, especially on Kerala and Kashmir group trips. The trip coordinators add a personal touch and keep travelers motivated, even during challenging journeys like the Kashmir trail. Overall, I would rate their group tours 4 out of 5.

However, I would not recommend them for personal trips such as honeymoons or family travel. My recent Kerala trip was outsourced to a third-party operator, which led to poor coordination, unhelpful driving services, substandard hotels, and an unpleasant houseboat experience. The worst stay was in Munnar, where basic infrastructure issues caused serious discomfort and affected my young child’s health causing him Acute Bronchitis. Despite these issues, there was no follow-up or apology from the company. As a long-time customer, this lack of accountability broke the trust I once had in them.

featured_reviews.name: Sonali Bhagat
featured_reviews.review_text:
A big thanks for our 3-day girls trip to Udaipur with The Time Traveller was truly a wonderful and memorable experience from start to finish. Everything was well planned and smoothly executed, which made the trip completely stress-free and enjoyable for all of us.
The 4-star hotel stay was excellent  the rooms were spacious, very clean, and comfortable, giving us the perfect place to relax after long sightseeing days. The food quality was another highlight; every meal was delicious, fresh, and well-prepared, catering well to our tastes and adding to the overall comfort of the trip.
For local travel, we were provided with an AC tempo traveler, which was clean, comfortable, and ideal for a group trip. It made traveling between spots easy and relaxed. A special mention goes to our guide Shishupal, who played a major role in making this trip successful. He was knowledgeable, friendly, and extremely cooperative. He guided us through every location according to the itinerary, shared useful insights about the places we visited, and ensured we never felt rushed or confused.
What really stood out was how he helped plan and manage our night-out experiences, making them safe, enjoyable, and perfectly timed. His local knowledge and planning skills truly enhanced our experience and allowed us to explore Udaipur confidently and comfortably.
Overall, the trip was well-organised, thoughtfully planned, and exceeded our expectations. The professionalism, coordination, and attention to detail by The Time Traveller made this journey special and memorable for us. Without a doubt, this experience has made us confident in choosing The Time Traveller again for our future trips, and we would highly recommend them to anyone planning a group or girls trip.
